title: ynh profile ls --format json
description: Output of `ynh profile ls <harness> --format json`. Bare array of the profiles a harness declares, summarised by what each one touches. Counts rather than contents: this answers "which profiles exist and what do they affect", while `ynh info` resolves one in full. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

name.description: The profile's name, and the value `--profile` takes.

hooks.description: Total hook entries across every event the profile declares. Profile hooks replace the harness's per event rather than merging, so a non-zero count means those events are overridden entirely.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers the profile declares. These deep-merge with the harness's, and a null entry removes an inherited server — so this count is servers mentioned, not necessarily servers added.

includes.description: Git or local includes the profile adds on top of the harness's.

env_passthrough.description: Environment variables the profile passes through. This replaces the harness-level list rather than extending it, so zero means the profile passes nothing, not that it inherits.
